name: n8n-nodes-human-in-the-loop-custom
description: n8n Community Node for human-in-the-loop link generation and wait/resume workflows
author: DNAngelX <stolly82@gmail.com>

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/credentials dist/nodes/CreateHitlLink dist/nodes/WaitForHitlResponse && cp credentials/hitl.svg dist/credentials/hitl.svg && cp nodes/CreateHitlLink/hitl.svg dist/nodes/CreateHitlLink/hitl.svg && cp nodes/WaitForHitlResponse/hitl.svg dist/nodes/WaitForHitlResponse/hitl.svg
scripts.release: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
